stories.title: Gold Glove Sweep Watch — Cubs Could Make History
stories.angle: PCA (CF), Happ (LF, 4 straight GGs), Suzuki (RF, NL leader in FRV) — three Cubs outfielders are Gold Glove contenders. No team has EVER swept all three outfield spots since Gold Gloves went position-by-position in 2011. Bittersweet: this trio may be splitting up this winter.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
PCA. Seiya. Happ.

Three Cubs outfielders, three Gold Glove contenders — and no team has ever swept all three outfield spots since Gold Gloves went position-by-position in 2011.

Could happen this November. Even if it's their last season together.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

research.facts:
Gold Glove Sweep Watch
**Decision:** NEW STORY (never covered in this pipeline; historic frame from MLB.com article)
**Tier:** 1
**Sources:**
1. MLB.com (Sept 11, 2026): "Could Cubs' best-in-show defense become 1st ever to sweep outfield Gold Gloves?" — multiple team-page reposts confirm this is an official MLB.com article — MEDIUM confidence (Sept 11, 28 days old; but historic framing remains valid until finalists announced)
2. NBC Chicago / Marquee Sports Network: Cubs Cubs NL Gold Glove context (2025 wins) — cross-reference ✓
**Key Facts:**
- No team has ever swept all three outfield Gold Glove positions since awards went position-by-position in 2011 (per MLB.com)
- PCA (CF): Won 2025 Gold Glove (first career), NL leader in FRV at CF per September 2026 preview
- Ian Happ (LF): 4 consecutive Gold Gloves (2022-2025); 5 FRV per Sept article (2nd in NL behind Jackson Chourio's 6)
- Seiya Suzuki (RF): 8 FRV, leads all NL right fielders per Sept article; 2nd-place Carson Benge at 5
- 2025 finalists announced "mid-October 2025" per CBS Sports; 2026 finalists expected late October 2026
- Bittersweet angle: all three outfielders may leave this winter (Happ FA, Suzuki FA; PCA under team control but team may rebuild)
**Freshness:** Sept 11 source is 28 days old, BUT: (1) no change expected until finalists announced late Oct; (2) historic/season-retrospective context remains valid ✓
**Confidence:** MEDIUM (Gold Glove finalists not yet officially announced for 2026; treating as likely based on season-long FRV data from MLB.com)
**Compound claim:** "No team has EVER swept all three outfield Gold Glove positions since 2011" — from MLB.com (authoritative source). Will note as MEDIUM in fact-check log; will soften language to "since Gold Gloves went position-by-position in 2011."
**Why Cubs fans care:** Historic milestone, rare positive news amid painful offseason. Bittersweet angle (trio may split up) adds emotional resonance.
